DQL reuses the timeseries/filter/fetch-spans grammar live-validated against oat05854.dev.apps.dynatracelabs.com for the sibling github-sync-health-dashboard.json; tiles render data once an apiserver carrying S2/S3 exports to the DT env and real vault traffic flows. Metric keys + span attributes match internal/apiserver/obsfunnel.go + secretwrite.go. The audit-trail tile is value-free by contract (enforced by TestNFR2ToolCredentialAuditSpansNoLeak).

variables.input: fetch spans, from:-24h | filter matchesPhrase(span.name, "ksquad.credential.") | fields credential.project | dedup credential.project

# Credential Vault — Audit & Telemetry
OTel audit for the mutating vault verbs on `/api/credentials`: **write** (`ksquad.credential.create`), **rotate** (`ksquad.credential.rotate`), **delete** (`ksquad.credential.delete`). Each emits an audit span with the masked tuple *(principal, type, project, namespace, outcome)* — **never the value**. SLOs: **rejected == 0**, **store_error == 0**. Contract: `docs/observability/credential-vault-audit-telemetry.md`.

1.title: Writes rejected (RBAC/admission) — SLO == 0
1.query: timeseries rejected = sum(ksquad.credential.create.requests, filter:{outcome=="rejected"}) + sum(ksquad.credential.rotate.requests, filter:{outcome=="rejected"}) + sum(ksquad.credential.delete.requests, filter:{outcome=="rejected"}), from:-1h

2.title: Credential store errors — SLO == 0
2.query: timeseries store_err = sum(ksquad.credential.create.requests, filter:{outcome=="store_error"}) + sum(ksquad.credential.rotate.requests, filter:{outcome=="store_error"}) + sum(ksquad.credential.delete.requests, filter:{outcome=="store_error"}), from:-1h

3.title: Write success rate — SLO >= 0.95
3.query: timeseries created = sum(ksquad.credential.create.requests, filter:{outcome=="created"}), total = sum(ksquad.credential.create.requests), from:-1h | fieldsAdd rate = arrayAvg(created) / arrayAvg(total)

5.title: Rotations vs deletes by outcome
5.query: timeseries rotates = sum(ksquad.credential.rotate.requests), deletes = sum(ksquad.credential.delete.requests), by:{outcome}, from:-1h

6.title: Audit trail — who changed which credential (value-free)
6.query: fetch spans, from:-24h | filter matchesPhrase(span.name, "ksquad.credential.") | fields timestamp, verb = span.name, principal = credential.principal, type = credential.type, project = credential.project, namespace = k8s.namespace.name, outcome | sort timestamp desc

7.title: Audit-span coverage — spans vs successful mutations
7.query: fetch spans, from:-1h | filter matchesPhrase(span.name, "ksquad.credential.") | filter in(outcome, {"created","rotated","deleted"}) | summarize span_count = count()
